descriptionHtml:
Approach · TC-14 In-Room Dictation & Note Generation · S03 Begin Encounter and the Encounter tab reach the same encounter view, the tab path from a chart with no pre-round note, both modes

UAT steps / ticket ACs covered:

  • U1 Both entry paths reach the same place: 'Begin Encounter' on the Pre-Round tab and the Encounter tab open the same encounter view (dictation box, Save & Extract, Generate). (UAT TC-14; TFA-92592 AC 1) — gate: blocked: TFA-92592 ready for pr
  • U14 Steps 1 to 4 are repeated in Nursing Home, and every expected result holds in both Hospital and Nursing Home. (UAT TC-14 step 5; UAT 3.3; TFA-92592 AC 14) — gate: blocked: TFA-92592 ready for pr

Test design technique: Equivalence classes (equivalence) — Check the same rule again with another class of input (Hospital / Nursing Home, other data); every class has to be right.

Given Fresh physician with the standard fixture (one Hospital patient, one Nursing Home resident, no pre-round notes)

When In each mode, on the cold chart (no pre-round note): open the Pre-Round tab (record whether Begin Encounter is offered), then open the Encounter tab from the tab strip (checkpoint). Then on Pre-Round type a pre-round note, press Save Note and press Begin Encounter (checkpoint)

Then Both paths show that patient's encounter view with the dictation box, Save & Extract and Generate, and no longer the Pre-Round 'Begin Encounter' button; the tab path works on a chart that has no pre-round note, which is the 'another patient' of step 1

Pass rule (oracle, excerpt): oracle.mjs: every encounter checkpoint mustContain the patient's name, 'Save & Extract' and 'Generate'; mustNotContain 'Begin Encounter' and the other mode's patient. Same controls in both encounter checkpoints of a mode = same place (U1). …

Where it ran: dev; test method AGENT · Browser agent; lane planned in the matrix: browser agent (automated)

S03 is our own case number (its number in the coverage matrix cases/TC-14.matrix.json), not a step number of the UAT document.

Environment: dev — dev deployment, build e02167f (Deploy Convex, 2026-10-12T18:24:27Z); account and address are not written into the report; run folder runs/2026-10-14-dev.

Test method: AGENT · Browser agent; secondary: PW · Playwright script — as classified in cases/test-methods.json, which says it runs on both; Source: dev.
